description: This file defines the 'Download' controller within the Account section of an OpenCart e-commerce project. It manages displaying downloadable items page with pagination and securely serving download files to authenticated users.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Controller class for handling user download actions, including listing downloads with pagination and serving files securely.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of downloadable items with pagination; verifies user login status and retrieves download data.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles the actual download request; performs user authentication, file existence checks, sets headers, and streams the file to the user.
